101-643-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-643-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3558-5006-6798-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-6798-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

396-728-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
396-728-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2922-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Obscura Storefront.
2922-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Obscura Storefront.
When Obscura Storefront enters, it and Tifa trigger.
Resolve the Tifa trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Resolve the Obscura Storefront trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

222-527-4247-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

330-5426-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.
330-5426-7839.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Insult // Injury.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2

1722-2034-2092-7365-7824.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
1722-2034-2092-7365-7824.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-2092-7365-7824.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

104-4186-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

2178-3967-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-5662-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1987-2239-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2239-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-2239-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

104-549-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-549-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4871-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2438-4871-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

4452-4997-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4452-4997-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1052-3175.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2438-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
2438-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2438-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

632-1903-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1903-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

4508-6847-7223.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-6847-7223.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Stalactite Dagger, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1329-7220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-7220.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Glamermite.
When Glamermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3129-5526-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-5526-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

147-997-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

413-2932-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
413-2932-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
413-2932-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-2292-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-2292-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2034-2781-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

880-3585-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3585-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4772-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Doubling Season.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-4772-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

325-2428-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
325-2428-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
325-2428-6282.description:
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Toluz's second ability triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2 if needed for each remaining trigger.
Discard down to your maximum hand size again, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat.

1445-2267-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-5147.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1283-2440-2905-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2440-2905-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite with haste.
When the token Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Pestermite.
Repeat.

1429-4875-5315-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4875-5315-5402.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

856-1808-4321-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

658-2510-3544-4050-5751.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil
658-2510-3544-4050-5751.description:
Cast Auramancer from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {W} and discarding Urza's Saga.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Urza's Saga from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auramancer, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2060-2577-3602-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2060-2577-3602-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2257-4508-5396.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2257-4508-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, giving Reckless Fireweaver the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Trickery Charm, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1760-2955-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.
1760-2955-4364.description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Justiciar's Portal without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Justiciar's Portal, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1000-2103-2493-2727.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2103-2493-2727.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast From Under the Floorboards by paying {3}{B}{B}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer and gaining 3 life.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Capture of Jingzhou, and From Under the Floorboards to your hand.
Repeat.

2210-4112.description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Mirrormade enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirrormade triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
